neighbours.label: a word-stem token that continues into a further piece of the same word (spectacular|ly, Gud|mund|sdottir)
fire: The sunset over the bay was spectacularly beautiful last night.
The paper cites earlier work by Gudmundsdottir and colleagues.
The wine was over-acidic and lacked any real fruit.
Her doctoral thesis on Ottoman trade was finished in May.
He placed a bet with Tipico Sportwetten before the match.
The crew worked unbelievably hard to finish before the storm.
The novel was translated by Sigurdardottir into English.
The singer performed remarkably well despite her cold.
quiet: The sunset over the bay was very beautiful last night.
The paper cites earlier work by Smith and colleagues.
The wine was too sour and lacked any real fruit.
Her long thesis on Ottoman trade was finished in May.
He placed a bet with a local bookmaker before the match.
The crew worked very hard to finish before the storm.
The novel was translated by Jones into English.
The singer performed very well despite her cold.

notes: card: word-internal pieces in Arabic, English, Icelandic names; output suppresses suffixes -ly, -ing, -ness
